stem: Vivaan places structures in this order: cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism. He looks at a skin cell, a sheet of similar skin cells working together, a kidney, and the urinary system that includes the kidneys.

statements.text: The sheet of similar skin cells working together is a tissue.
The kidney is an organ system because it contains many cell types.
The urinary system is an organ system in the sequence before the whole organism.

teacher.key_rationale: Similar cells working together form a tissue; a kidney is an organ; the urinary system is an organ system. Calling the kidney an organ system skips a level.
